summary: CareTrust REIT filed an 8-K to report the exercise of the underwriters' option to purchase an additional 1,875,000 shares in a previously disclosed public offering of common stock. The additional shares were sold at $40.225 per share via forward sale agreements with Wells Fargo and JPMorgan. This is a routine follow-up on a shelf takedown; no special situation is involved. The filing includes the forward sale agreements and a legal opinion on share validity. No recommendation or advisor is noted. What to watch: forward settlement mechanics and stock price drift.
